newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks ease in London on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks ease in London on profit-taking.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were weaker in London as a wave of profit-taking that started in Hong Kong continued, dealers said.
At 1402 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference index was down 65.98 points at 13,975.92.
"We saw some profit-taking and consolidation in the index overnight and now we're just looking at a general markdown," said one dealer.
HSBC Holdings, which has been among the best performers, led the decline. The stock was trading about HK$1.50 below its Hong Kong close,dealers said.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index closed 111.68 points lower at 14,041.90 after having climbed to a fresh peak at 14,167.01 earlier.
